instruction: Using the opened Graphisoft/Archicad environment and the official Graphisoft/Archicad command-line or automation interfaces available in the environment, complete the model work from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and save the finished deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. For the steps below, invoke Archicad from `C:\Program Files\GRAPHISOFT\Archicad 27\Archicad.exe` when running the automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process the IFC file outside the Graphisoft/Archicad toolchain. The current model is a compact two-storey apartment block with paired living, kitchen, and bedroom spaces under a simple roof. The housing manager wants a small ground-floor mail and parcel lobby plus a separated refuse store, while the apartment rooms, roof form, and existing external shell remain unchanged. Add the support spaces and door records so daily management can separate resident mail, parcel pickup, and refuse handling.
